host_boundary: T11 owns typed list_tree and read_note on the existing ipc_invoke union. Both commands require ExplicitRouteArgs (workspace + project) on every call. Pagination follows scripts/core.py fail-closed cursor semantics. Note read returns title, identifier, markdown body, and an observation that does not treat a success envelope as disk proof. Production default is EmptyLibrary: list_tree returns empty entries, read_note returns unsupported. Tests inject FixtureLibrary over BMDock-owned temp markdown. T11 does not start rmcp, mix engine profiles, expose callTool, write/edit/move/delete notes, scan user Obsidian vaults, %APPDATA%, or global Basic Memory home. Official list_directory / read_note MCP remain UNVERIFIED. T07 remains the owner of engine lifecycle. P0 bmdock-probe and just contract/contract-main stay independent. just build stays the G0 probe. just dev remains the T08 Tauri shell.

AC19.claim: list_tree takes optional cursor and bounded page_size (reject 0 / >64 as schema). Responses include entries[], next_cursor (null on last page), page, truncated=false. Invalid cursor, repeated next-cursor loops, and truncated/partial inventory fail closed as schema or unsupported. The command does not dump the entire tree as one unbounded success.

AC22.claim: read_note returns title, identifier, markdown body, and observation (envelope_is_not_disk_proof=true). Fixture tests write BMDock-owned Chinese markdown with a wiki link in a temp owned dir and assert the returned body equals the physical file (classified_as=body_matches_disk, disk_verified=true). Envelope-only success is accepted_unverified and not disk_verified. Empty library listing is empty state, not a user-vault success; empty-library read_note is unsupported.

AC33.claim: read_note uses a note identifier/permalink/title field, not a user-vault filesystem path. Extra path fields are schema. Filesystem-looking identifiers are policy and do not open the path. Official engine remains the future data owner via NoteLibrary; production EmptyLibrary does not call rmcp. Live official list_directory / read_note MCP is UNVERIFIED and was not run as T11 proof. Dual profiles stay isolated (release c0bd87c6 / 21 vs main-preview 3452c821 / 27) and are not merged into tree/read responses.

AC46.claim: Workbench preview shows markdown in a pre element as text. App.tsx has no dangerouslySetInnerHTML and no innerHTML. T11 does not write, edit, move, or delete notes.
